name: P10 — Direction-specific rubric
description: P10: completeness and scientific quality under the accompanying task specification. Integrity is evaluated in the separate integrity rubric.

deliverables.title: Deliverable presence (Tier 1 gates)
deliverables.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does proposal/report.pdf exist with substantive content (full sections, not a placeholder)?
leaves.evidence: Filesystem check: stat proposal/report.pdf; open and verify it has methodology, noise-model, results, mechanism, and conclusion sections.

yes.description: report.pdf exists and contains a substantive paper.
yes.criteria: PDF exists, parses cleanly, and contains Methodology / Noise Model / Results / Analysis / Conclusion sections (or equivalents) with non-placeholder content.

no.criteria: PDF absent, malformed, or contains only placeholder text.

leaves.question: Does proposal/logs/ exist with non-empty per-run records?
leaves.evidence: Filesystem check: ls proposal/logs/; spot-check files for actual run output.

yes.description: logs directory present with run records.
yes.criteria: proposal/logs/ exists with files documenting noiseless-anchor, per-noise-level, threshold-analysis, and exact-diagonalization reference runs.

no.criteria: Directory absent, empty, or contains only placeholder files.

leaves.question: Are noiseless-anchor reproduction runs logged for all four required configurations (U=0 trivial, U=0 nontrivial, U=10 trivial, U=10 nontrivial)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/: look for a noiseless_anchor/ or similarly named subdirectory with per-configuration Berry phase, fidelity, and depth/CNOT traces.

yes.criteria: Logs record the noiseless Berry phase, output fidelity, and per-layer CNOT and depth traces for each of U=0/U=10 x trivial/nontrivial.

no.description: One or more noiseless-anchor runs missing.
no.criteria: Logs missing for at least one of the four required configurations.

leaves.question: Are per-(configuration, noise-level, seed) noise-sweep runs logged, recording the noise parameters, shot count, Berry phase, deviation from the exact reference, and infidelity?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/: look for a noise_sweep/ subdirectory with per-run records over the swept noise grid.

yes.criteria: Each swept point logs the noise-model rates (two-qubit error, readout error, T1/T2), the shot count, the computed Berry phase, |phi_B - phi_B_ED|, and the output infidelity; multiple seeds per point are present.

no.criteria: No per-run sweep records, or the grid is too sparse to resolve a threshold, or seeds absent.

leaves.question: Is the threshold-extraction analysis logged (the extracted threshold with its uncertainty for each required configuration, produced by the pre-stated rule)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/: look for a threshold_analysis/ artifact recording the extracted threshold and uncertainty per configuration.

yes.criteria: A logged artifact records the extracted threshold with seed-derived uncertainty for U=0 and U=10, computed from the sweep by the pre-stated extraction rule.

no.criteria: No logged threshold-extraction artifact, or thresholds appear only in the paper with no logged source.

leaves.question: Are the runtime exact-diagonalization Berry-phase references (0 and pi) logged, computed by an independent pipeline?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/: look for exact-diagonalization reference records for each required configuration.

yes.criteria: Logs record the runtime-computed exact-diagonalization Berry phase (0 in the trivial regime, pi in the nontrivial regime) for each configuration from the model Hamiltonian, not hardcoded.

no.criteria: No logged runtime ED reference, or references are hardcoded rather than computed.

leaves.question: Is the primary results table present in the paper (labeled tab:main_results) reporting, per configuration, the noiseless and under-noise Berry phase, deviation from the exact reference, threshold with uncertainty in device units, depth, and N_CX?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex or report.pdf: locate the table by label tab:main_results.

yes.description: Main results table present and complete.
yes.criteria: Table labeled tab:main_results has rows for each configuration with columns for Berry phase (noiseless and at threshold), |phi_B - phi_B_ED|, threshold in device-referenced units, depth, and N_CX.

no.description: Main results table missing or incomplete.
no.criteria: Table absent, missing configurations or columns, or values are placeholders.

leaves.question: Are the required result figures present: Berry-phase-error-versus-noise-strength curves for both U regimes (with the threshold crossing and seed error bars), plus the infidelity-versus-noise trend and the shots-versus-phase-uncertainty relationship?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex or report.pdf: figure(s) plotting phase error vs noise strength for U=0 and U=10.

yes.description: Noise curves present with error bars.
yes.criteria: Figures plot Berry-phase deviation vs noise strength for both U=0 and U=10 (threshold crossing against the tolerance, seed-derived error bars), and the infidelity-versus-noise trend and shots-versus-phase-uncertainty relationship are both shown.

no.criteria: The Berry-phase-error curves are absent, cover only one U regime, or lack error bars / a visible threshold crossing; or the infidelity-versus-noise and shots-versus-uncertainty figures are both entirely absent from the results.

leaves.question: Does proposal/codebase_notes.md exist with substantive content documenting what was inspected in data/figshare_data/ and any external simulation code reused?
leaves.evidence: Filesystem check + content inspection.

yes.criteria: File exists with non-trivial content documenting the figshare trace schema, the noiseless Berry-phase and resource numbers used for cross-checking, and any external library reused (for instance the density-matrix simulator, OpenFermion for Jordan-Wigner).

no.criteria: File absent, empty, or contains only placeholder text.

leaves.question: Is proposal/attempts_log.md present and substantive when partial / unresolved work is claimed?
leaves.evidence: Filesystem check + content inspection; cross-reference with paper claims of partial/failed work.

yes.description: Attempts log substantive (or unused but present).
yes.criteria: File exists and either documents distinct approaches with stated rationale, or the paper claims no partial work.

no.description: Attempts log missing when partial work is claimed.
no.criteria: Paper claims partial/failed/unresolved work but attempts_log.md is absent or trivial.

leaves.question: Does the paper contain a Methodology section stating the noise model, phase estimator, accuracy criterion, and threshold-extraction rule before any results?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex section order; check that the noise study is fully specified in Methodology ahead of Results.

yes.criteria: An explicit Methodology (or equivalent) section states the noise channels and rates, the phase estimator, the accuracy tolerance, and the threshold-extraction rule, appearing before any empirical results.

no.criteria: No Methodology section, or the noise study is specified only alongside or after results.

method_specification.title: Noise-study specification
method_specification.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Is the noise model (channels, rates, how each maps onto the circuit, the shot model) fully stated in the Methodology before any empirical results?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex section order; check that all noise channels, rates, and the shot model appear in Methodology, not Results.

yes.criteria: Every noise channel, its rate, its mapping onto circuit operations, and the finite-shot model are stated in Methodology before any empirical numbers are shown.

no.description: Noise model introduced or refined in Results.
no.criteria: Channels, rates, or the shot model first appear after empirical results, or are altered mid-paper without acknowledgment.

leaves.question: Is the noise model specified completely enough that a domain expert could reproduce the noise study from the paper alone?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex Methodology / Noise Model section; check for precise channels, rates, gate-time keying, and the noise-strength parameterization.

fully_specified.criteria: All four required channels are given with numeric rates and a stated device profile; T1/T2 are keyed to gate times and depth; the readout-error and two-qubit-error models are defined; the noise-strength sweep parameter and shot axis are defined precisely enough to reproduce the study without reading the code.

mostly_specified.criteria: Most channels stated with numeric rates but at least one (for instance the exact T1/T2 gate-time keying or the crosstalk/coherent term if included) requires reading the code to disambiguate.

qualitative_only.criteria: Noise model described in prose without numeric rates or a precise sweep parameterization sufficient for reproduction.

leaves.question: Is the phase estimator specified, and does it address that the Hadamard test reads phi_qc (not phi_B), so the single real-part readout P_{|0>}=(1+cos phi_qc)/2 is ill-conditioned wherever phi_qc sits near a quantized value (vanishing slope)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex Methodology; check the estimator definition and its conditioning at the quantized targets.

well_conditioned_estimator.description: Well-conditioned estimator at the quantized targets.
well_conditioned_estimator.criteria: The estimator stays well-conditioned wherever phi_qc sits near 0 or pi (for instance by also measuring the imaginary part of the overlap so the slope does not vanish), with the estimator and its conditioning stated explicitly.

single_estimator_justified.criteria: A single real-part readout is used but the paper explicitly justifies its reliability at the operating point (for instance a stated sensitivity/variance analysis, or a demonstration that phi_qc sits far enough from 0/pi there).

single_realpart_unjustified.description: Single real-part readout without justifying conditioning.
single_realpart_unjustified.criteria: The single real-part Hadamard readout is used where phi_qc sits near a quantized value with no treatment of its vanishing-slope ill-conditioning.

leaves.question: Are the accuracy tolerance epsilon and the threshold-extraction rule stated before any results?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex Methodology; check that the tolerance and extraction rule precede all empirical numbers.

yes.criteria: A concrete accuracy tolerance epsilon and a concrete threshold-extraction rule (the largest noise strength at which the estimate stays within epsilon) are both stated in Methodology before any results, with the tolerance defined on the branch-consistent (circular / principal-value) quantity |phi_B - phi_B_ED| and the 2pi branch policy stated (relevant for U=10, where the raw phi_B is an odd multiple of pi).

no.description: Tolerance or extraction rule not pre-stated.
no.criteria: The tolerance or the extraction rule is missing, vague, or first appears alongside/after the results.

leaves.question: Does the paper preserve the held-fixed AVQITE+AVQDS Berry-phase framework and characterize it, rather than substituting a new algorithm?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex Methodology; cross-check that the McLachlan EOM, adaptive disjoint-support ansatz growth, time-reversed loop, and phi_B=phi_qc+phi_G readout are preserved.

yes.criteria: The McLachlan variational principle and EOM, the adaptive disjoint-support ansatz growth, the RK4 integrator, the UCCSD-like pool, the time-reversed adiabatic loop, and the Hadamard-test readout with phi_B=phi_qc+phi_G are all preserved; the contribution is the noise characterization, not a new ground-state-preparation or dynamics method.

no.description: Method substituted or altered without disclosure.
no.criteria: The submission replaces or materially modifies a held-fixed component (for instance a different ground-state-preparation or dynamics method) without an explicit disclosed comparison.

baseline_verification.title: Noiseless-anchor verification
baseline_verification.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the noiseless re-implementation reproduce the paper's Berry-phase values (0 in the trivial regime, pi in the nontrivial regime) in both U regimes?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/ noiseless-anchor Berry phases vs the exact-diagonalization references and the figshare traces, judged AFTER the stated branch/fold convention (the figshare phase traces are unfolded/wrapped, not a clean 0/pi column; the reported phase is reconstructed and folded to the principal value). Do not penalize a correct-but-unfolded reproduction that matches once the convention is applied.

reproduced_both_regimes.criteria: Noiseless Berry phase matches the exact-diagonalization reference to ~1e-3 or better, giving 0 in the trivial regime and pi in the nontrivial regime, for both U=0 and U=10.

reproduced_one_regime.description: Reproduced in one U regime only.
reproduced_one_regime.criteria: The quantized Berry phases are reproduced for one of U=0 / U=10 but not the other.

not_reproduced.criteria: Noiseless Berry phases do not match the exact reference in either regime, so the anchor is unverified.

leaves.question: Do the reproduced circuit resources match the paper for the agent's stated (delta, T) (peak depth of order tens of layers for U=0 and up to a few hundred for U=10, U=10 several times deeper than U=0, nontrivial region costing more CNOTs)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/ noiseless-anchor depth/CNOT traces vs the figshare results*p0.h5 traces.

matches.criteria: Reproduced peak depths agree with the figshare traces at the agent's stated (delta, T) within a small factor, fall within the paper-spanned band (roughly 47-106 layers for U=0, 82-279 for U=10), U=10 is several times deeper than U=0, and the CNOT ordering (nontrivial > trivial) matches.

approximate.criteria: Resources are of the right order and ordering but deviate more than a small factor from the figshare traces at the stated (delta, T), with the deviation noted -- provided the nontrivial > trivial AND U=10 > U=0 orderings are BOTH preserved. If either ordering is inverted relative to the figshare traces, this value does NOT apply and the value is mismatch, even when the deviation is disclosed and explained.

mismatch.criteria: Reported depths/CNOT counts disagree with the figshare traces at the agent's stated (delta, T), or fall well outside the paper-spanned band with no explanation, or invert the U=10 > U=0 / nontrivial > trivial ordering (a disclosed and explained inversion still counts as mismatch -- an inverted ordering is dispositive here), suggesting an incorrect re-implementation.

leaves.question: Are the held-fixed constraints (algorithm, hyperparameter floor L2_cut=1e-4 and delta-theta-max=0.01, SSHH test bed) respected in the noiseless anchor, with any deviation disclosed?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/ run configs + proposal/report.tex; check L2_cut <= 1e-4, delta-theta-max=0.01, N=4 / 8 qubits / U in {0,10}, twist on spin-up only.

yes.criteria: Logged configs show L2_cut <= 1e-4 (not loosened), delta-theta-max=0.01, the SSHH chain at N=4 / 8 qubits with the twist on spin-up fermions only, and both U=0 and U=10; any deviation is explicitly disclosed with an isolating comparison.

no.criteria: A held-fixed item is violated (for instance L2_cut loosened above 1e-4 to trim depth) without disclosure, or the logs contradict a compliance claim.

experimental_completeness.title: Experimental completeness
experimental_completeness.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Were the noise experiments run for both U=0 and U=10?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/ coverage across U regimes.

yes.criteria: Noise-sweep and threshold-analysis runs exist for both U=0 and U=10.

no.criteria: One of U=0 / U=10 has no noise experiments.

leaves.question: Were the noise experiments run for both the topologically trivial (phi_B=0) and nontrivial (phi_B=pi) regimes?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/ coverage across topological regimes within each U.

yes.criteria: Noise-sweep runs exist for both the trivial and nontrivial dimerization within each U regime, giving all four required configurations under noise.

no.criteria: At least one topological regime has no noise experiments within some U.

leaves.question: Are multiple seeds run per swept point so the reported quantities carry error bars?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/ per-point seed repeats; proposal/report.tex error bars on curves and thresholds.

sufficient.criteria: Each swept point is repeated over multiple seeds and the phase-error curves and extracted thresholds carry seed-derived uncertainty.

single_seed.criteria: Runs use a single seed per point, so reported quantities lack seed-derived error bars.

absent.criteria: No seed repetition and no uncertainty on the reported quantities.

leaves.question: Is the noise sweep dense enough in noise strength (and shots) to resolve the threshold crossing?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/ swept-grid density; proposal/report.tex curves showing the crossing.

yes.criteria: The noise-strength grid brackets the tolerance crossing with enough points that the threshold is localized rather than falling between two coarse levels; a shots axis is also swept.

no.criteria: The grid is too coarse to localize the crossing, or the shots axis is not swept.

required_noise_sources.title: Required noise sources faithfully modeled (Tier 2 gate)
required_noise_sources.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Is the shot_sampling noise source present and faithfully modeled, acting on the actual circuit in a genuine simulation?
leaves.evidence: proposal/code/ noise-model implementation for shot_sampling; proposal/logs/ rates and shot counts; cross-check against the Methodology description.

faithfully_modeled.criteria: The shot_sampling source is injected on the actual circuit (for shot_sampling: outcomes drawn by real finite sampling of the measured probability, e.g. binomial draws at the logged shot count; for two_qubit_gate / readout / thermal_relaxation: a genuine channel applied per gate/measurement/depth in a density-matrix or trajectory simulation), with its executed rate documented for scientific assessment.

present_but_flawed.criteria: The shot_sampling source is included but its application is flawed (for instance an analytic variance substituted for real sampling, or a channel applied to the wrong operations).

absent.criteria: The shot_sampling source is not modeled, or is emulated by perturbing the final phase rather than acting on the circuit.

present_but_flawed.criteria: The two_qubit_gate source is included but its application is flawed (for instance an analytic variance substituted for real sampling, or a channel applied to the wrong operations).

absent.criteria: The two_qubit_gate source is not modeled, or is emulated by perturbing the final phase rather than acting on the circuit.

present_but_flawed.criteria: The readout source is included but its application is flawed (for instance an analytic variance substituted for real sampling, or a channel applied to the wrong operations).

absent.criteria: The readout source is not modeled, or is emulated by perturbing the final phase rather than acting on the circuit.

noise_scope.title: Whole-method noise scope (Tier 2 gate)
noise_scope.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Are the quantum-measured phi_G integrands evaluated under the required noise along the frozen trajectory, as well as phi_qc? Grade the executed noise scope independently of disclosure.
leaves.evidence: proposal/code/ phi_G evaluation path + proposal/logs/; check that <H> and the geometric-connection overlaps are re-estimated under noise (finite shots plus the circuit channels) at the frozen theta(t), and that the reported threshold reflects a noisy phi_B = phi_qc + phi_G. Confirm the phi_G-integrand circuits are the actual connection-overlap circuits (a distinct, more numerous circuit family than the single phi_qc readout), evaluated per integration node along the trajectory, not a re-sampled phi_qc proxy or a single loop-end evaluation.

tiers.name: noised
tiers.description: Both required phi_G integrands and the readout carry the specified stochastic noise.

tiers.name: phi_g_exact
tiers.description: One or more required phi_G integrands are kept exact; the required scientific scope is not met, whether disclosed or not.

tiers.name: not_established
tiers.description: The executed phi_G noise treatment cannot be established.

threshold_characterization.title: Noise-threshold characterization per U regime (Tier 2 gate)
threshold_characterization.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: On configuration u0, is the noise threshold characterized rigorously with uncertainty, by the pre-stated extraction rule?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/threshold_analysis/ for u0; proposal/report.tex threshold value and uncertainty.

rigorous_with_uncertainty.criteria: A threshold is extracted for u0 by the pre-stated rule with seed-derived uncertainty, backed by a degradation curve that brackets the tolerance crossing.

point_estimate_no_uncertainty.criteria: A threshold is extracted for u0 but without seed-derived uncertainty.

curve_only_no_threshold.criteria: A degradation curve is shown for u0 but no threshold is extracted from it.

not_characterized.criteria: No degradation curve or threshold for u0.

leaves.question: On configuration u0, is the threshold reported in device-referenced units at a stated reference shot count S_ref (equivalent two-qubit error rate, readout error, T1/T2), together with a separately reported minimum-shots floor S*?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex + tab:main_results for u0; check the units of the reported threshold.

device_referenced.criteria: The u0 threshold is expressed as an equivalent two-qubit error rate, readout error, and T1/T2 at a stated reference shot count S_ref, with a separately reported minimum-shots floor S*, so it is interpretable as accurate below roughly X two-qubit error at S_ref shots and needing at least S* shots.

abstract_units_only.criteria: The u0 threshold is reported only in an abstract scalar noise-strength unit without a device-referenced mapping, or without a stated reference shot count / minimum-shots floor.

leaves.question: On configuration u10, is the noise threshold characterized rigorously with uncertainty, by the pre-stated extraction rule?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/threshold_analysis/ for u10; proposal/report.tex threshold value and uncertainty.

rigorous_with_uncertainty.criteria: A threshold is extracted for u10 by the pre-stated rule with seed-derived uncertainty, backed by a degradation curve that brackets the tolerance crossing.

point_estimate_no_uncertainty.criteria: A threshold is extracted for u10 but without seed-derived uncertainty.

curve_only_no_threshold.criteria: A degradation curve is shown for u10 but no threshold is extracted from it.

not_characterized.criteria: No degradation curve or threshold for u10.

leaves.question: On configuration u10, is the threshold reported in device-referenced units at a stated reference shot count S_ref (equivalent two-qubit error rate, readout error, T1/T2), together with a separately reported minimum-shots floor S*?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex + tab:main_results for u10; check the units of the reported threshold.

device_referenced.criteria: The u10 threshold is expressed as an equivalent two-qubit error rate, readout error, and T1/T2 at a stated reference shot count S_ref, with a separately reported minimum-shots floor S*, so it is interpretable as accurate below roughly X two-qubit error at S_ref shots and needing at least S* shots.

abstract_units_only.criteria: The u10 threshold is reported only in an abstract scalar noise-strength unit without a device-referenced mapping, or without a stated reference shot count / minimum-shots floor.

topological_discrimination.title: Topological-phase discrimination under noise (Tier 2 gate)
topological_discrimination.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: On configuration u0, are the trivial (phi_B=0) and nontrivial (phi_B=pi) regimes correctly distinguished below the extracted threshold?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/ and proposal/report.tex for u0: compare the under-noise Berry phase in the trivial vs nontrivial regime below threshold.

distinguished_below_threshold.criteria: Below the extracted threshold on u0, the under-noise Berry phase separates the trivial regime (near 0) from the nontrivial regime (near pi) by a circular (principal-value) margin exceeding the seed-derived uncertainty, computed on the circle so estimates near the +/-pi branch boundary are compared correctly.

one_regime_only.criteria: Only one topological regime is characterized under noise on u0, so discrimination cannot be assessed.

not_shown.criteria: The two regimes are not compared under noise on u0, or they are not separable below the claimed threshold.

leaves.question: On configuration u10, are the trivial (phi_B=0) and nontrivial (phi_B=pi) regimes correctly distinguished below the extracted threshold?
leaves.evidence: proposal/logs/ and proposal/report.tex for u10: compare the under-noise Berry phase in the trivial vs nontrivial regime below threshold.

distinguished_below_threshold.criteria: Below the extracted threshold on u10, the under-noise Berry phase separates the trivial regime (near 0) from the nontrivial regime (near pi) by a circular (principal-value) margin exceeding the seed-derived uncertainty, computed on the circle so estimates near the +/-pi branch boundary are compared correctly.

one_regime_only.criteria: Only one topological regime is characterized under noise on u10, so discrimination cannot be assessed.

not_shown.criteria: The two regimes are not compared under noise on u10, or they are not separable below the claimed threshold.

mechanism_analysis.title: Mechanism analysis
mechanism_analysis.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the paper contain an explicit subsection on mechanism analysis?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex section structure; check for a Mechanism subsection or equivalent.

yes.criteria: An explicit subsection (possibly named Mechanism, Why-the-threshold, or similar) analyzes the noise degradation.

no.criteria: Paper reports thresholds without an explicit mechanism subsection.

leaves.question: How deeply does the mechanism analysis explain where the threshold sits?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex Mechanism subsection content.

deep.criteria: Analysis isolates the dominant contributing factor via controlled comparison, connects the behavior to the algorithm's structure (depth, CNOT count, readout), and predicts where the method should and should not tolerate noise.

moderate.criteria: Analysis identifies a contributing factor but does not isolate it via controlled comparison or connect it to the algorithm's structure.

shallow.criteria: Analysis restates the threshold results without explaining the underlying mechanism.

leaves.question: Does the analysis engage correctly with the fate of the noiseless phi_G+phi_qc cancellation under noise for the scope actually run -- distinguishing the deterministic bias (which the shared frozen trajectory can make partially cancel) from the independent stochastic fluctuations (whose variances add), and recognizing that phi_G,1 = -int<H>dt' is a dynamical-phase leg distinct from the phi_qc/phi_G,2 overlaps?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex Mechanism subsection; check the treatment of the phi_qc, phi_G,1, and phi_G,2 noise contributions (deterministic vs stochastic).

engaged_rigorously.criteria: Analysis engages rigorously with the physics for the scope run: it distinguishes the deterministic bias the contributions share through the frozen trajectory (which can partially cancel, e.g. the non-adiabatic residual the paper cancels in Appendix A) from their independent shot/incoherent fluctuations (drawn on separate circuits, so variances add and do not cancel by sharing the trajectory), AND it treats phi_G,1 = -int<H>dt' as a dynamical-phase leg whose integrated <H> noise is a non-cancelling bias/random-walk distinct from the phi_qc/phi_G,2 overlaps -- supported with evidence (a phi_qc-only vs phi_G,1-vs-phi_G,2 decomposition, or per-channel isolation), and not resting on a cancellation that is an artifact of noising phi_G via a copy of the phi_qc circuit (which would make the two contributions trivially correlated). Under a DISCLOSED phi_G-exact scope it instead reasons rigorously about whether the phi_qc-only stochastic error breaks the noiseless cancellation; under the optional noisy-construction scope it analyzes how a stochastic (noisy-M,V) trajectory changes the picture.

mentioned.criteria: The cancellation question is mentioned but not supported with evidence, or is framed as one lumped phi_qc-vs-phi_G question without distinguishing deterministic (may cancel) from stochastic (variances add) errors or recognizing the distinct phi_G,1 integrated-<H> dynamical-phase leg.

not_addressed.criteria: The paper does not address whether the noiseless cancellations survive stochastic noise.

leaves.question: Does the analysis identify which noise source or circuit property (depth, CNOT count, single-ancilla readout) dominates the degradation?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex Mechanism subsection + supporting logs.

identified.criteria: The dominant noise source or circuit property is identified and supported by evidence (for instance per-channel isolation or a depth/CNOT correlation).

partial.criteria: A candidate dominant factor is named but the supporting evidence is incomplete or does not isolate it from the others.

absent.criteria: No dominant source or circuit property is identified.

failure_analysis.title: Failure analysis
failure_analysis.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the paper contain an explicit failure-analysis subsection?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex section structure.

yes.criteria: An explicit subsection discusses where and why the method degrades under noise.

no.criteria: Paper does not discuss failure/degradation cases.

leaves.question: Does the failure analysis engage with the depth dependence between the shallow U=0 and the several-times-deeper U=10 circuits?
leaves.evidence: Failure subsection content; compare degradation between U=0 and U=10 against their depths.

engaged.criteria: Analysis connects the difference in noise tolerance between U=0 and U=10 to their depth (U=10 several times deeper) and CNOT counts, supported by the threshold results.

mentioned.criteria: The depth difference is mentioned but not connected to the observed degradation.

absent.criteria: The depth dependence between U=0 and U=10 is not discussed.

leaves.question: Are the observed degradation patterns explained coherently and tied to the algorithm's structure or the noise model?
leaves.evidence: Failure subsection content.

coherent.criteria: Each identified degradation pattern is connected to a specific structural property (depth, CNOT count, readout) or noise channel with a coherent argument.

partial.criteria: Some patterns are identified but the explanations are incomplete or only partially tied to structure.

absent.criteria: Patterns are observed without coherent explanation, or none are identified.

leaves.question: Does the paper contain an explicit computational-cost subsection?

yes.criteria: An explicit subsection discusses the classical simulation cost of the noise characterization.

no.criteria: Paper does not discuss the simulation cost.

leaves.question: Is the simulation cost of the noise study quantified (the cost of the density-matrix/trajectory simulation over the noise-level, seed, and configuration grid)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex compute-cost subsection + proposal/logs/ timing records.

quantified.criteria: The classical cost is quantified (for instance wall-clock per run and the total number of sweep points and seeds), giving a concrete picture of where compute goes.

optional_extensions.title: Optional extensions (differentiators)
optional_extensions.purpose: Assess the task's applicable scientific or completeness requirements for this cluster; integrity is assessed separately.

leaves.question: Does the noise model go beyond the four required sources (for instance single-qubit gate error, coherent over/under-rotation, crosstalk)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex Noise Model + proposal/logs/; check for additional channels beyond the four required.

broad.criteria: At least one scientifically motivated channel beyond the four required (for instance single-qubit error, coherent over-rotation, crosstalk) is modeled and swept, with results reported.

required_only.criteria: Only the four required noise sources are modeled.

leaves.question: Is a shallow-vs-deep noise-tolerance comparison (AVQDS vs Trotter at matched noiseless accuracy) demonstrated?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex + proposal/logs/ Trotter-baseline-under-noise runs.

demonstrated.criteria: A Trotterized adiabatic baseline is run under the same noise at matched noiseless accuracy and its noise threshold is compared against AVQDS, supporting the shallow-circuit noise-tolerance claim with logged evidence.

attempted.criteria: The comparison is attempted but incomplete (for instance no matched noiseless accuracy or no extracted Trotter threshold), with the gap documented.

absent.criteria: No Trotter noise-tolerance comparison is presented.

leaves.question: Is an error-mitigation technique demonstrated, and does it measurably raise the threshold?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex + proposal/logs/ error-mitigation runs; compare mitigated vs unmitigated thresholds.

demonstrated_raises_threshold.criteria: An error-mitigation technique is applied and the mitigated threshold is measurably higher than the unmitigated threshold, with logged evidence.

attempted.criteria: Error mitigation is applied but does not measurably raise the threshold, or the comparison is incomplete.

leaves.question: Does the study additionally feed sampling noise back into the classical construction loop (noisy M,V estimation and hence a noisy McLachlan integration)?
leaves.evidence: proposal/report.tex + proposal/logs/ noisy-construction runs.

demonstrated.criteria: The study injects sampling noise into the M,V estimation so the McLachlan integration and ansatz growth are driven by noisy signals (a stochastic trajectory), beyond the required frozen-trajectory scope, with results reported.

absent.criteria: The trajectory is frozen at its noiseless values and noise enters only the readout and the phi_G-integrand measurements (the required scope), without feeding noisy M,V back into the McLachlan integration.

journal_quality.criteria: Clear thesis, claims supported by evidence, prose-driven main sections (not bullet lists), careful citations.

reasonable.criteria: Structure and prose are clear but lack some polish (bullet lists in main body, occasional unsupported claims).

poor.criteria: Disorganized structure, prose absent, or claims regularly unsupported.

tiers.name: perfunctory

leaves.question: Is the rendered PDF free of formatting issues (overflows, broken refs, missing figures, cut-off tables)?

clean.criteria: No equation overflow, no broken cross-references, all figures and tables render correctly.

minor_issues.criteria: A few cosmetic issues (a single overflow, one broken reference) that do not impede reading.

major_issues.criteria: Equations overflow, references broken, figures cut off, or tables overflow text width in a way that impedes reading.

no.criteria: Table absent, missing configurations or columns, or values are placeholders.

assessment_policy.scope: Completeness and scientific quality only: required artifacts, executed experimental coverage, reproducible methodology, mathematical/statistical validity, performance targets, and task-required analysis/writing.
assessment_policy.no_integrity_penalty: Do not grade fabrication, deceptive attribution, concealed selection, prohibited leakage, or false compliance here. Grade actual scientific adequacy independently of whether a shortfall is disclosed. Integrity evidence is assessed only in integrity_check_rubric.json.
assessment_policy.authoritative_task: The accompanying unchanged task specification controls required versus optional work and permitted exceptions. A qualitative quality tier is not authority to introduce a new experiment, resource limit, or numerical minimum absent from the task.
assessment_policy.conditional_nodes: Respect applicability. Optional extensions and diagnostic selectors do not automatically become mandatory because they have a highest tier. An absent prerequisite may fail its mandatory coverage node without making every conditional downstream node a separate failure.
assessment_policy.inference: Insufficient scientific support is not itself dishonesty. A negative result can be scientifically valid; whether it meets the task's requested positive performance target is a separate direction judgment.
